verses.original: בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַיִּסְע֖וּ וַֽיַּחֲנוּ֙ בְּעַֽרְב֣וֹת מוֹאָ֔ב לְיַרְדֵּ֥ן מֵעֵ֖בֶר יְרֵחֽוֹ׃ס
verses.transliteration: bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl way·yis·‘ū way·ya·ḥă·nū bə·‘ar·ḇō·wṯ mō·w·’āḇ lə·yar·dên mê·‘ê·ḇer yə·rê·ḥōw
verses.literal: Then the Israelites . . . traveled on and camped in the plains of Moab near the Jordan across from Jericho

verses.original: בָּלָ֖ק בֶּן־ צִפּ֑וֹר אֵ֛ת וַיַּ֥רְא כָּל־ אֲשֶׁר־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל עָשָׂ֥ה לָֽאֱמֹרִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: bā·lāq ben- ṣip·pō·wr ’êṯ way·yar kāl- ’ă·šer- yiś·rā·’êl ‘ā·śāh lā·’ĕ·mō·rî
verses.literal: Now Balak son of Zippor - saw all that Israel had done to the Amorites

verses.original: מוֹאָ֜ב וַיָּ֨גָר מִפְּנֵ֥י הָעָ֛ם מְאֹ֖ד כִּ֣י ה֑וּא רַב־ מוֹאָ֔ב מִפְּנֵ֖י וַיָּ֣קָץ בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: mō·w·’āḇ way·yā·ḡār mip·pə·nê hā·‘ām mə·’ōḏ kî hū raḇ- mō·w·’āḇ mip·pə·nê way·yā·qāṣ bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: and Moab was terrified of the people . . . because they were numerous Indeed, Moab . . . dreaded the Israelites . . .

verses.original: מוֹאָ֜ב וַיֹּ֨אמֶר אֶל־ זִקְנֵ֣י מִדְיָ֗ן עַתָּ֞ה הַקָּהָל֙ אֶת־ יְלַחֲכ֤וּ כָּל־ סְבִ֣יבֹתֵ֔ינוּ הַשּׁ֔וֹר אֵ֖ת כִּלְחֹ֣ךְ יֶ֣רֶק הַשָּׂדֶ֑ה וּבָלָ֧ק בֶּן־ צִפּ֛וֹר מֶ֥לֶךְ לְמוֹאָ֖ב הַהִֽוא׃ בָּעֵ֥ת
verses.transliteration: mō·w·’āḇ way·yō·mer ’el- ziq·nê miḏ·yān ‘at·tāh haq·qā·hāl ’eṯ- yə·la·ḥă·ḵū kāl- sə·ḇî·ḇō·ṯê·nū haš·šō·wr ’êṯ kil·ḥōḵ ye·req haś·śā·ḏeh ū·ḇā·lāq ben- ṣip·pō·wr me·leḵ lə·mō·w·’āḇ ha·hi·w bā·‘êṯ
verses.literal: So the Moabites said to the elders of Midian . . . This horde - will devour everything around us as an ox - licks up the grass of the field Since Balak son of Zippor was king of Moab at that time

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁלַ֨ח מַלְאָכִ֜ים אֶל־ בִּלְעָ֣ם בֶּן־ בְּע֗וֹר פְּ֠תוֹרָה אֲשֶׁ֧ר עַל־ הַנָּהָ֛ר אֶ֥רֶץ בְּנֵי־ עַמּ֖וֹ הִ֠נֵּה עַ֣ם יָצָ֤א מִמִּצְרַ֙יִם֙ לִקְרֹא־ ל֑וֹ לֵאמֹ֗ר הִנֵּ֤ה כִסָּה֙ אֶת־ עֵ֣ין הָאָ֔רֶץ וְה֥וּא יֹשֵׁ֖ב מִמֻּלִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·laḥ mal·’ā·ḵîm ’el- bil·‘ām ben- bə·‘ō·wr pə·ṯō·w·rāh ’ă·šer ‘al- han·nā·hār ’e·reṣ bə·nê- ‘am·mōw hin·nêh ‘am yā·ṣā mim·miṣ·ra·yim liq·rō- lōw lê·mōr hin·nêh ḵis·sāh ’eṯ- ‘ên hā·’ā·reṣ wə·hū yō·šêḇ mim·mu·lî
verses.literal: he sent messengers to {summon} Balaam son of Beor at Pethor which is by the Euphrates in the land of his people . . . Behold a people has come out of Egypt said Balak - - They cover - the face of the land . . . and have settled next to me

verses.original: נָּ֨א לְכָה־ וְעַתָּה֩ אָֽרָה־ לִּ֜י אֶת־ הַזֶּ֗ה הָעָ֣ם כִּֽי־ הוּא֙ עָצ֥וּם מִמֶּ֔נִּי אוּלַ֤י אוּכַל֙ נַכֶּה־ בּ֔וֹ וַאֲגָרְשֶׁ֖נּוּ מִן־ הָאָ֑רֶץ כִּ֣י יָדַ֗עְתִּי אֵ֤ת אֲשֶׁר־ תְּבָרֵךְ֙ מְבֹרָ֔ךְ וַאֲשֶׁ֥ר תָּאֹ֖ר יוּאָֽר׃
verses.transliteration: nā lə·ḵāh- wə·‘at·tāh ’ā·rāh- lî ’eṯ- haz·zeh hā·‘ām kî- hū ‘ā·ṣūm mim·men·nî ’ū·lay ’ū·ḵal nak·keh- bōw wa·’ă·ḡā·rə·šen·nū min- hā·’ā·reṣ kî yā·ḏa‘·tî ’êṯ ’ă·šer- tə·ḇā·rêḵ mə·ḇō·rāḵ wa·’ă·šer tā·’ōr yū·’ār
verses.literal: So please come now and put a curse - on this people because they are too mighty for me Perhaps I may be able to defeat them and drive them out of the land for I know - that those you bless are blessed and those you curse are cursed

verses.original: זִקְנֵ֤י מוֹאָב֙ וְזִקְנֵ֣י מִדְיָ֔ן וַיֵּ֨לְכ֜וּ וּקְסָמִ֖ים בְּיָדָ֑ם וַיָּבֹ֙אוּ֙ אֶל־ בִּלְעָ֔ם וַיְדַבְּר֥וּ אֵלָ֖יו דִּבְרֵ֥י בָלָֽק׃
verses.transliteration: ziq·nê mō·w·’āḇ wə·ziq·nê miḏ·yān way·yê·lə·ḵū ū·qə·sā·mîm bə·yā·ḏām way·yā·ḇō·’ū ’el- bil·‘ām way·ḏab·bə·rū ’ê·lāw diḇ·rê ḇā·lāq
verses.literal: The elders of Moab . . . and Midian departed with the fees for divination in hand They came to Balaam and relayed to him the words of Balak

verses.original: לִ֤ינוּ הַלַּ֔יְלָה פֹה֙ וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֲלֵיהֶ֗ם וַהֲשִׁבֹתִ֤י אֶתְכֶם֙ דָּבָ֔ר כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר יְהוָ֖ה יְדַבֵּ֥ר אֵלָ֑י שָׂרֵֽי־ מוֹאָ֖ב וַיֵּשְׁב֥וּ עִם־ בִּלְעָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: lî·nū hal·lay·lāh p̄ōh way·yō·mer ’ă·lê·hem wa·hă·ši·ḇō·ṯî ’eṯ·ḵem dā·ḇār ka·’ă·šer Yah·weh yə·ḏab·bêr ’ê·lāy śā·rê- mō·w·’āḇ way·yê·šə·ḇū ‘im- bil·‘ām
verses.literal: Spend the night here [Balaam] replied . . . and I will give - you the answer that the LORD speaks to me So the princes of Moab stayed with Balaam

verses.original: אֱלֹהִ֖ים וַיָּבֹ֥א אֶל־ בִּלְעָ֑ם וַיֹּ֕אמֶר מִ֛י הָאֵ֖לֶּה הָאֲנָשִׁ֥ים עִמָּֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: ’ĕ·lō·hîm way·yā·ḇō ’el- bil·‘ām way·yō·mer mî hā·’êl·leh hā·’ă·nā·šîm ‘im·māḵ
verses.literal: Then God came to Balaam and asked Who are these men with you

verses.original: בִּלְעָ֖ם וַיֹּ֥אמֶר אֶל־ הָאֱלֹהִ֑ים בָּלָ֧ק בֶּן־ צִפֹּ֛ר מֶ֥לֶךְ מוֹאָ֖ב שָׁלַ֥ח אֵלָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: bil·‘ām way·yō·mer ’el- hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm bā·lāq ben- ṣip·pōr me·leḵ mō·w·’āḇ šā·laḥ ’ê·lāy
verses.literal: And Balaam said to God Balak son of Zippor king of Moab sent me this message

verses.original: הִנֵּ֤ה הָעָם֙ הַיֹּצֵ֣א מִמִּצְרַ֔יִם וַיְכַ֖ס אֶת־ עֵ֣ין הָאָ֑רֶץ עַתָּ֗ה לְכָ֤ה קָֽבָה־ אֹת֔וֹ לִּי֙ אוּלַ֥י אוּכַ֛ל לְהִלָּ֥חֶם בּ֖וֹ וְגֵרַשְׁתִּֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: hin·nêh hā·‘ām hay·yō·ṣê mim·miṣ·ra·yim way·ḵas ’eṯ- ‘ên hā·’ā·reṣ ‘at·tāh lə·ḵāh qā·ḇāh- ’ō·ṯōw lî ’ū·lay ’ū·ḵal lə·hil·lā·ḥem bōw wə·ḡê·raš·tîw
verses.literal: Behold a people has come out of Egypt and they cover - the face of the land Now come and put a curse on them for me Perhaps I may be able to fight against them and drive them away

verses.original: אֱלֹהִים֙ וַיֹּ֤אמֶר אֶל־ בִּלְעָ֔ם לֹ֥א תֵלֵ֖ךְ עִמָּהֶ֑ם לֹ֤א תָאֹר֙ אֶת־ הָעָ֔ם כִּ֥י הֽוּא׃ בָר֖וּךְ
verses.transliteration: ’ĕ·lō·hîm way·yō·mer ’el- bil·‘ām lō ṯê·lêḵ ‘im·mā·hem lō ṯā·’ōr ’eṯ- hā·‘ām kî hū ḇā·rūḵ
verses.literal: But God said to Balaam Do not go with them You are not to curse - this people for they are blessed

verses.original: בִּלְעָם֙ וַיָּ֤קָם בַּבֹּ֔קֶר וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ אֶל־ בָלָ֔ק שָׂרֵ֣י לְכ֖וּ אֶֽל־ אַרְצְכֶ֑ם כִּ֚י יְהוָ֔ה מֵאֵ֣ן לְתִתִּ֖י לַהֲלֹ֥ךְ עִמָּכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: bil·‘ām way·yā·qām bab·bō·qer way·yō·mer ’el- ḇā·lāq śā·rê lə·ḵū ’el- ’ar·ṣə·ḵem kî Yah·weh mê·’ên lə·ṯit·tî la·hă·lōḵ ‘im·mā·ḵem
verses.literal: So Balaam got up the next morning and said to Balak’s princes Go back to your homeland because the LORD has refused to let me go with you

verses.original: שָׂרֵ֣י מוֹאָ֔ב וַיָּק֙וּמוּ֙ וַיָּבֹ֖אוּ אֶל־ בָּלָ֑ק וַיֹּ֣אמְר֔וּ בִּלְעָ֖ם מֵאֵ֥ן הֲלֹ֥ךְ עִמָּֽנוּ׃
verses.transliteration: śā·rê mō·w·’āḇ way·yā·qū·mū way·yā·ḇō·’ū ’el- bā·lāq way·yō·mə·rū bil·‘ām mê·’ên hă·lōḵ ‘im·mā·nū
verses.literal: And the princes of Moab arose returned to Balak and said Balaam refused to come with us

verses.original: בָּלָ֑ק שְׁלֹ֣חַ וַיֹּ֥סֶף שָׂרִ֔ים ע֖וֹד רַבִּ֥ים וְנִכְבָּדִ֖ים מֵאֵֽלֶּה׃
verses.transliteration: bā·lāq šə·lō·aḥ way·yō·sep̄ śā·rîm ‘ō·wḏ rab·bîm wə·niḵ·bā·ḏîm mê·’êl·leh
verses.literal: Then Balak sent other princes . . . more numerous and more distinguished than the [first messengers]

verses.original: וַיָּבֹ֖אוּ אֶל־ בִּלְעָ֑ם וַיֹּ֣אמְרוּ ל֗וֹ כֹּ֤ה בָּלָ֣ק בֶּן־ צִפּ֔וֹר אָמַר֙ נָ֥א אַל־ תִמָּנַ֖ע מֵהֲלֹ֥ךְ אֵלָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·ḇō·’ū ’el- bil·‘ām way·yō·mə·rū lōw kōh bā·lāq ben- ṣip·pō·wr ’ā·mar nā ’al- ṯim·mā·na‘ mê·hă·lōḵ ’ê·lāy
verses.literal: They came to Balaam and said This is what Balak son of Zippor says Please let nothing hinder you from coming to me

verses.original: כִּֽי־ כַבֵּ֤ד מְאֹ֔ד אֲכַבֶּדְךָ֙ אֶֽעֱשֶׂ֑ה וְכֹ֛ל אֲשֶׁר־ תֹּאמַ֥ר אֵלַ֖י נָּא֙ וּלְכָה־ קָֽבָה־ לִּ֔י אֵ֖ת הַזֶּֽה׃ הָעָ֥ם
verses.transliteration: kî- ḵab·bêḏ mə·’ōḏ ’ă·ḵab·beḏ·ḵā ’e·‘ĕ·śeh wə·ḵōl ’ă·šer- tō·mar ’ê·lay nā ū·lə·ḵāh- qā·ḇāh- lî ’êṯ haz·zeh hā·‘ām
verses.literal: for I will honor you richly . . . and do whatever - you say . . . So please come and put a curse - on this people for me

verses.original: בִּלְעָ֗ם וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ וַיַּ֣עַן אֶל־ עַבְדֵ֣י בָלָ֔ק אִם־ בָלָ֛ק יִתֶּן־ לִ֥י בֵית֖וֹ מְלֹ֥א כֶּ֣סֶף וְזָהָ֑ב אוּכַ֗ל לֹ֣א לַעֲשׂ֥וֹת קְטַנָּ֖ה א֥וֹ גְדוֹלָֽה׃ לַעֲבֹר֙ אֶת־ פִּי֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהָ֔י
verses.transliteration: bil·‘ām way·yō·mer way·ya·‘an ’el- ‘aḇ·ḏê ḇā·lāq ’im- ḇā·lāq yit·ten- lî ḇê·ṯōw mə·lō ke·sep̄ wə·zā·hāḇ ’ū·ḵal lō la·‘ă·śō·wṯ qə·ṭan·nāh ’ōw ḡə·ḏō·w·lāh la·‘ă·ḇōr ’eṯ- pî Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hāy
verses.literal: But Balaam . . . replied to the servants of Balak If Balak were to give me his house full of silver and gold I could not do anything small or great to go beyond - the command of the LORD my God

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֗ה נָ֥א שְׁב֨וּ בָזֶ֛ה הַלָּ֑יְלָה גַּם־ אַתֶּ֖ם וְאֵ֣דְעָ֔ה מַה־ יֹּסֵ֥ף יְהוָ֖ה דַּבֵּ֥ר עִמִּֽי׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘at·tāh nā šə·ḇū ḇā·zeh hal·lā·yə·lāh gam- ’at·tem wə·’ê·ḏə·‘āh mah- yō·sêp̄ Yah·weh dab·bêr ‘im·mî
verses.literal: So now please stay here overnight as the others did . . . that I may find out what else the LORD has to tell me . . .

verses.original: לַיְלָה֒ אֱלֹהִ֥ים׀ וַיָּבֹ֨א אֶל־ בִּלְעָם֮ וַיֹּ֣אמֶר ל֗וֹ אִם־ הָאֲנָשִׁ֔ים בָּ֣אוּ לִקְרֹ֤א לְךָ֙ ק֖וּם לֵ֣ךְ אִתָּ֑ם וְאַ֗ךְ אֶת־ הַדָּבָ֛ר תַעֲשֶֽׂה׃ אֲשֶׁר־ אֲדַבֵּ֥ר אֵלֶ֖יךָ אֹת֥וֹ
verses.transliteration: lay·lāh ’ĕ·lō·hîm way·yā·ḇō ’el- bil·‘ām way·yō·mer lōw ’im- hā·’ă·nā·šîm bā·’ū liq·rō lə·ḵā qūm lêḵ ’it·tām wə·’aḵ ’eṯ- had·dā·ḇār ṯa·‘ă·śeh ’ă·šer- ’ă·ḏab·bêr ’ê·le·ḵā ’ō·ṯōw
verses.literal: That night God came to Balaam and said Since these men have come to summon you get up and go with them but you must only - - do what I tell you . . . -

verses.original: בַּבֹּ֔קֶר בִּלְעָם֙ וַיָּ֤קָם וַֽיַּחֲבֹ֖שׁ אֶת־ אֲתֹנ֑וֹ וַיֵּ֖לֶךְ עִם־ שָׂרֵ֥י מוֹאָֽב׃
verses.transliteration: bab·bō·qer bil·‘ām way·yā·qām way·ya·ḥă·ḇōš ’eṯ- ’ă·ṯō·nōw way·yê·leḵ ‘im- śā·rê mō·w·’āḇ
verses.literal: So in the morning Balaam got up saddled - his donkey and went with the princes of Moab

verses.original: אֱלֹהִים֮ אַ֣ף וַיִּֽחַר־ כִּֽי־ הוּא֒ הוֹלֵ֣ךְ מַלְאַ֧ךְ יְהוָ֛ה וַיִּתְיַצֵּ֞ב בַּדֶּ֖רֶךְ לְשָׂטָ֣ן ל֑וֹ וְהוּא֙ רֹכֵ֣ב עַל־ אֲתֹנ֔וֹ וּשְׁנֵ֥י נְעָרָ֖יו עִמּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ’ĕ·lō·hîm ’ap̄ way·yi·ḥar- kî- hū hō·w·lêḵ mal·’aḵ Yah·weh way·yiṯ·yaṣ·ṣêḇ bad·de·reḵ lə·śā·ṭān lōw wə·hū rō·ḵêḇ ‘al- ’ă·ṯō·nōw ū·šə·nê nə·‘ā·rāw ‘im·mōw
verses.literal: Then God’s anger was kindled because Balaam was going along and the angel of the LORD stood in the road to oppose him Balaam was riding . . . his donkey and his two servants were with him

verses.original: הָאָתוֹן֩ אֶת־ וַתֵּ֣רֶא מַלְאַ֨ךְ יְהוָ֜ה נִצָּ֣ב בַּדֶּ֗רֶךְ שְׁלוּפָה֙ וְחַרְבּ֤וֹ בְּיָד֔וֹ הָֽאָתוֹן֙ וַתֵּ֤ט מִן־ הַדֶּ֔רֶךְ וַתֵּ֖לֶךְ בַּשָּׂדֶ֑ה בִּלְעָם֙ אֶת־ וַיַּ֤ךְ הָ֣אָת֔וֹן לְהַטֹּתָ֖הּ הַדָּֽרֶךְ׃
verses.transliteration: hā·’ā·ṯō·wn ’eṯ- wat·tê·re mal·’aḵ Yah·weh niṣ·ṣāḇ bad·de·reḵ šə·lū·p̄āh wə·ḥar·bōw bə·yā·ḏōw hā·’ā·ṯō·wn wat·têṭ min- had·de·reḵ wat·tê·leḵ baś·śā·ḏeh bil·‘ām ’eṯ- way·yaḵ hā·’ā·ṯō·wn lə·haṭ·ṭō·ṯāh had·dā·reḵ
verses.literal: When the donkey - saw the angel of the LORD standing in the road with a drawn sword in his hand she turned off the path and went into a field So Balaam - beat her to return her to the path

verses.original: מַלְאַ֣ךְ יְהוָ֔ה וַֽיַּעֲמֹד֙ בְּמִשְׁע֖וֹל הַכְּרָמִ֑ים גָּדֵ֥ר מִזֶּ֖ה וְגָדֵ֥ר מִזֶּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: mal·’aḵ Yah·weh way·ya·‘ă·mōḏ bə·miš·‘ō·wl hak·kə·rā·mîm gā·ḏêr miz·zeh wə·ḡā·ḏêr miz·zeh
verses.literal: Then the angel of the LORD stood in a narrow passage between two vineyards with walls on either side . . . . . .

verses.original: הָאָת֜וֹן אֶת־ וַתֵּ֨רֶא מַלְאַ֣ךְ יְהוָ֗ה וַתִּלָּחֵץ֙ אֶל־ הַקִּ֔יר וַתִּלְחַ֛ץ אֶת־ בִּלְעָ֖ם רֶ֥גֶל אֶל־ הַקִּ֑יר לְהַכֹּתָֽהּ׃ וַיֹּ֖סֶף
verses.transliteration: hā·’ā·ṯō·wn ’eṯ- wat·tê·re mal·’aḵ Yah·weh wat·til·lā·ḥêṣ ’el- haq·qîr wat·til·ḥaṣ ’eṯ- bil·‘ām re·ḡel ’el- haq·qîr lə·hak·kō·ṯāh way·yō·sep̄
verses.literal: And the donkey - saw the angel of the LORD and pressed herself against the wall crushing - Balaam’s foot against it So he beat her once again

verses.original: מַלְאַךְ־ יְהוָ֖ה עֲב֑וֹר וַיּ֥וֹסֶף וַֽיַּעֲמֹד֙ צָ֔ר בְּמָק֣וֹם אֲשֶׁ֛ר אֵֽין־ דֶּ֥רֶךְ לִנְט֖וֹת יָמִ֥ין וּשְׂמֹֽאול׃
verses.transliteration: mal·’aḵ- Yah·weh ‘ă·ḇō·wr way·yō·w·sep̄ way·ya·‘ă·mōḏ ṣār bə·mā·qō·wm ’ă·šer ’ên- de·reḵ lin·ṭō·wṯ yā·mîn ū·śə·mō·wl
verses.literal: And the angel of the LORD moved on ahead and stood in a narrow place where there was no room to turn to the right or left

verses.original: הָֽאָתוֹן֙ אֶת־ וַתֵּ֤רֶא מַלְאַ֣ךְ יְהוָ֔ה וַתִּרְבַּ֖ץ תַּ֣חַת בִּלְעָ֑ם בִּלְעָ֔ם וַיִּֽחַר־ אַ֣ף וַיַּ֥ךְ אֶת־ הָאָת֖וֹן בַּמַּקֵּֽל׃
verses.transliteration: hā·’ā·ṯō·wn ’eṯ- wat·tê·re mal·’aḵ Yah·weh wat·tir·baṣ ta·ḥaṯ bil·‘ām bil·‘ām way·yi·ḥar- ’ap̄ way·yaḵ ’eṯ- hā·’ā·ṯō·wn bam·maq·qêl
verses.literal: When the donkey - saw the angel of the LORD she lay down under Balaam and [he] became furious . . . and beat - [her] with his staff

verses.original: יְהוָ֖ה אֶת־ וַיִּפְתַּ֥ח הָאָת֑וֹן פִּ֣י וַתֹּ֤אמֶר לְבִלְעָם֙ מֶה־ עָשִׂ֣יתִֽי לְךָ֔ כִּ֣י הִכִּיתַ֔נִי זֶ֖ה שָׁלֹ֥שׁ רְגָלִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh ’eṯ- way·yip̄·taḥ hā·’ā·ṯō·wn pî wat·tō·mer lə·ḇil·‘ām meh- ‘ā·śî·ṯî lə·ḵā kî hik·kî·ṯa·nî zeh šā·lōš rə·ḡā·lîm
verses.literal: Then the LORD - opened the donkey’s mouth and she said to Balaam What have I done to you that you have beaten me these three times

verses.original: בִּלְעָם֙ וַיֹּ֤אמֶר לָֽאָת֔וֹן כִּ֥י הִתְעַלַּ֖לְתְּ בִּ֑י ל֤וּ יֶשׁ־ חֶ֙רֶב֙ בְּיָדִ֔י כִּ֥י הֲרַגְתִּֽיךְ׃ עַתָּ֖ה
verses.transliteration: bil·‘ām way·yō·mer lā·’ā·ṯō·wn kî hiṯ·‘al·lalt bî lū yeš- ḥe·reḇ bə·yā·ḏî kî hă·raḡ·tîḵ ‘at·tāh
verses.literal: Balaam answered the donkey . . . You have made a fool of me If I had a sword in my hand . . . I would kill you right now

verses.original: הָאָת֜וֹן אֶל־ וַתֹּ֨אמֶר בִּלְעָ֗ם אָנֹכִ֨י הֲלוֹא֩ אֲתֹֽנְךָ֜ אֲשֶׁר־ רָכַ֣בְתָּ עָלַ֗י מֵעֽוֹדְךָ֙ עַד־ הַיּ֣וֹם הַזֶּ֔ה לַעֲשׂ֥וֹת לְךָ֖ כֹּ֑ה הַֽהַסְכֵּ֣ן הִסְכַּ֔נְתִּי לֹֽא׃ וַיֹּ֖אמֶר
verses.transliteration: hā·’ā·ṯō·wn ’el- wat·tō·mer bil·‘ām ’ā·nō·ḵî hă·lō·w ’ă·ṯō·nə·ḵā ’ă·šer- rā·ḵaḇ·tā ‘ā·lay mê·‘ō·wḏ·ḵā ‘aḏ- hay·yō·wm haz·zeh la·‘ă·śō·wṯ lə·ḵā kōh ha·has·kên his·kan·tî lō way·yō·mer
verses.literal: But the donkey . . . said to Balaam Am I not the donkey - you have ridden . . . all your life until today . . . . . . Have I ever treated you this way before . . . No he replied

verses.original: יְהוָה֮ אֶת־ וַיְגַ֣ל בִלְעָם֒ עֵינֵ֣י וַיַּ֞רְא אֶת־ מַלְאַ֤ךְ יְהוָה֙ נִצָּ֣ב בַּדֶּ֔רֶךְ שְׁלֻפָ֖ה וְחַרְבּ֥וֹ בְּיָד֑וֹ וַיִּשְׁתַּ֖חוּ וַיִּקֹּ֥ד לְאַפָּֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh ’eṯ- way·ḡal ḇil·‘ām ‘ê·nê way·yar ’eṯ- mal·’aḵ Yah·weh niṣ·ṣāḇ bad·de·reḵ šə·lu·p̄āh wə·ḥar·bōw bə·yā·ḏōw way·yiš·ta·ḥū way·yiq·qōḏ lə·’ap·pāw
verses.literal: Then the LORD - opened Balaam’s eyes and he saw - the angel of the LORD standing in the road with a drawn sword in his hand And Balaam bowed low . . . and fell facedown

verses.original: מַלְאַ֣ךְ יְהוָ֔ה וַיֹּ֤אמֶר אֵלָיו֙ עַל־ מָ֗ה הִכִּ֙יתָ֙ אֶת־ אֲתֹ֣נְךָ֔ זֶ֖ה שָׁל֣וֹשׁ רְגָלִ֑ים הִנֵּ֤ה אָנֹכִי֙ יָצָ֣אתִי לְשָׂטָ֔ן כִּֽי־ הַדֶּ֖רֶךְ יָרַ֥ט לְנֶגְדִּֽי׃
verses.transliteration: mal·’aḵ Yah·weh way·yō·mer ’ê·lāw ‘al- māh hik·kî·ṯā ’eṯ- ’ă·ṯō·nə·ḵā zeh šā·lō·wōš rə·ḡā·lîm hin·nêh ’ā·nō·ḵî yā·ṣā·ṯî lə·śā·ṭān kî- had·de·reḵ yā·raṭ lə·neḡ·dî
verses.literal: The angel of the LORD asked him . . . Why . . . have you beaten - your donkey these three times Behold I have come out to oppose you because your way is perverse before me

verses.original: הָֽאָת֔וֹן וַתִּרְאַ֙נִי֙ וַתֵּ֣ט לְפָנַ֔י זֶ֖ה שָׁלֹ֣שׁ רְגָלִ֑ים אוּלַי֙ נָטְתָ֣ה מִפָּנַ֔י עַתָּ֛ה גַּם־ כִּ֥י הָרַ֖גְתִּי אֹתְכָ֥ה וְאוֹתָ֥הּ הֶחֱיֵֽיתִי׃
verses.transliteration: hā·’ā·ṯō·wn wat·tir·’a·nî wat·têṭ lə·p̄ā·nay zeh šā·lōš rə·ḡā·lîm ’ū·lay nā·ṭə·ṯāh mip·pā·nay ‘at·tāh gam- kî hā·raḡ·tî ’ō·ṯə·ḵāh wə·’ō·w·ṯāh he·ḥĕ·yê·ṯî
verses.literal: The donkey saw me and turned away from me these three times If she had not turned away - then by now . . . vvv I would surely have killed you and {let} her live

verses.original: חָטָ֔אתִי בִּלְעָ֜ם וַיֹּ֨אמֶר אֶל־ מַלְאַ֤ךְ יְהוָה֙ כִּ֚י לֹ֣א יָדַ֔עְתִּי כִּ֥י אַתָּ֛ה נִצָּ֥ב בַּדָּ֑רֶךְ לִקְרָאתִ֖י וְעַתָּ֛ה אִם־ רַ֥ע בְּעֵינֶ֖יךָ אָשׁ֥וּבָה לִּֽי׃
verses.transliteration: ḥā·ṭā·ṯî bil·‘ām way·yō·mer ’el- mal·’aḵ Yah·weh kî lō yā·ḏa‘·tî kî ’at·tāh niṣ·ṣāḇ bad·dā·reḵ liq·rā·ṯî wə·‘at·tāh ’im- ra‘ bə·‘ê·ne·ḵā ’ā·šū·ḇāh lî
verses.literal: I have sinned Balaam said to the angel of the LORD for I did not realize that you were standing in the road to confront me And now if this is displeasing in your sight I will go back [home]

verses.original: מַלְאַ֨ךְ יְהוָ֜ה וַיֹּאמֶר֩ אֶל־ בִּלְעָ֗ם לֵ֚ךְ עִם־ הָ֣אֲנָשִׁ֔ים אֲדַבֵּ֥ר אֵלֶ֖יךָ אֹת֣וֹ וְאֶ֗פֶס אֶת־ הַדָּבָ֛ר אֲשֶׁר־ תְדַבֵּ֑ר בִּלְעָ֖ם וַיֵּ֥לֶךְ עִם־ שָׂרֵ֥י בָלָֽק׃
verses.transliteration: mal·’aḵ Yah·weh way·yō·mer ’el- bil·‘ām lêḵ ‘im- hā·’ă·nā·šîm ’ă·ḏab·bêr ’ê·le·ḵā ’ō·ṯōw wə·’e·p̄es ’eṯ- had·dā·ḇār ’ă·šer- ṯə·ḏab·bêr bil·‘ām way·yê·leḵ ‘im- śā·rê ḇā·lāq
verses.literal: But the angel of the LORD said to Balaam Go with the men but you are to speak . . . - only - - what I tell you So Balaam went with the princes of Balak

verses.original: בָּלָ֖ק וַיִּשְׁמַ֥ע כִּ֣י בִלְעָ֑ם בָ֣א וַיֵּצֵ֨א לִקְרָאת֜וֹ אֶל־ מוֹאָ֗ב אֲשֶׁר֙ עִ֣יר עַל־ אַרְנֹ֔ן אֲשֶׁ֖ר גְּב֣וּל בִּקְצֵ֥ה הַגְּבֽוּל׃
verses.transliteration: bā·lāq way·yiš·ma‘ kî ḇil·‘ām ḇā way·yê·ṣê liq·rā·ṯōw ’el- mō·w·’āḇ ’ă·šer ‘îr ‘al- ’ar·nōn ’ă·šer gə·ḇūl biq·ṣêh hag·gə·ḇūl
verses.literal: When Balak heard that Balaam was coming he went out to meet him at the Moabite - city on the Arnon - border at the edge of his territory

verses.original: בָּלָ֜ק וַיֹּ֨אמֶר אֶל־ בִּלְעָ֗ם הֲלֹא֩ שָׁלֹ֨חַ שָׁלַ֤חְתִּי אֵלֶ֙יךָ֙ לִקְרֹא־ לָ֔ךְ לָ֥מָּה לֹא־ הָלַ֖כְתָּ אֵלָ֑י הַֽאֻמְנָ֔ם לֹ֥א אוּכַ֖ל כַּבְּדֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: bā·lāq way·yō·mer ’el- bil·‘ām hă·lō šā·lō·aḥ šā·laḥ·tî ’ê·le·ḵā liq·rō- lāḵ lām·māh lō- hā·laḵ·tā ’ê·lāy ha·’um·nām lō ’ū·ḵal kab·bə·ḏe·ḵā
verses.literal: And [he] said to Balaam Did I not send you an urgent summons . . . . . . . . . . . . Why vvv did you not come to me Am I really not able to reward you richly

verses.original: הִֽנֵּה־ בָ֙אתִי֙ אֵלֶ֔יךָ בִּלְעָ֜ם וַיֹּ֨אמֶר אֶל־ בָּלָ֗ק עַתָּ֕ה הֲיָכ֥וֹל אוּכַ֖ל דַּבֵּ֣ר מְא֑וּמָה אֲדַבֵּֽר׃ הַדָּבָ֗ר אֲשֶׁ֨ר אֱלֹהִ֛ים יָשִׂ֧ים בְּפִ֖י אֹת֥וֹ
verses.transliteration: hin·nêh- ḇā·ṯî ’ê·le·ḵā bil·‘ām way·yō·mer ’el- bā·lāq ‘at·tāh hă·yā·ḵō·wl ’ū·ḵal dab·bêr mə·’ū·māh ’ă·ḏab·bêr had·dā·ḇār ’ă·šer ’ĕ·lō·hîm yā·śîm bə·p̄î ’ō·ṯōw
verses.literal: See I have come to you Balaam replied - - - . . . but can I say just anything I must speak only the word that God puts in my mouth -

verses.original: בִּלְעָ֖ם וַיֵּ֥לֶךְ עִם־ בָּלָ֑ק וַיָּבֹ֖אוּ קִרְיַ֥ת חֻצֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: bil·‘ām way·yê·leḵ ‘im- bā·lāq way·yā·ḇō·’ū qir·yaṯ ḥu·ṣō·wṯ
verses.literal: So Balaam accompanied . . . Balak and they came vvv to Kiriath-huzoth

verses.original: בָּלָ֖ק וַיִּזְבַּ֥ח בָּקָ֣ר וָצֹ֑אן וַיְשַׁלַּ֣ח לְבִלְעָ֔ם וְלַשָּׂרִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר אִתּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: bā·lāq way·yiz·baḥ bā·qār wā·ṣōn way·šal·laḥ lə·ḇil·‘ām wə·laś·śā·rîm ’ă·šer ’it·tōw
verses.literal: Balak sacrificed cattle and sheep and he gave [portions] to Balaam and the princes who were with him

verses.original: וַיְהִ֣י בַבֹּ֔קֶר בָּלָק֙ אֶת־ וַיִּקַּ֤ח בִּלְעָ֔ם וַֽיַּעֲלֵ֖הוּ בָּמ֣וֹת בָּ֑עַל מִשָּׁ֖ם וַיַּ֥רְא קְצֵ֥ה הָעָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî ḇab·bō·qer bā·lāq ’eṯ- way·yiq·qaḥ bil·‘ām way·ya·‘ă·lê·hū bā·mō·wṯ bā·‘al miš·šām way·yar qə·ṣêh hā·‘ām
verses.literal: vvv The next morning Balak - took Balaam and brought him up to Bamoth-baal From there he could see the outskirts of the camp of the people
